_readme: Pills shown in the platform filter. 'platform' filters by platform id (see data/platforms.csv); 'type' filters by content_type. Icon and colour come from platforms.csv unless set here. 'embedHosts' lists the only sites allowed to load as embeds.

embeds._readme: Embed settings per platform. ratio = width/height of the player; shortRatio is used for reels and shorts. Paste a normal link into embed_url (youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtu.be/..., instagram.com/p/... or /reel/..., facebook.com/.../videos/...) and the site builds the official embed. Hosts must be listed in embedHosts.
